subject.title: marketplace-crons: MercadoLibre devuelve 429 al descargar etiquetas de envío

question: Should MercadoLibre label 429s fail visibly after a bounded retry budget, or should the queue keep deferring them until a real label is obtained?
rationale: The current code already has a bounded 10-delivery retry budget; changing that budget or the terminal behavior affects operator visibility, queue pressure, and whether orders remain blocked for hours.

options.title: Bounded retry plus visible error
options.body: Respect `Retry-After` when present, keep a bounded retry budget, and persist a retriable label error on the orderSell when the budget is exhausted.

options.title: Indefinite deferred retry
options.body: Keep labels pending and keep deferring 429s until MercadoLibre allows the download, accepting longer queue occupancy to avoid manual recovery.

options.title: Operational-only tuning
options.body: Leave code as-is and handle remaining 429s through provider quota or deployment/runtime tuning outside this issue.

recommendation.title: Bounded retry plus visible error
recommendation.body: Respect `Retry-After` when present, keep a bounded retry budget, and persist a retriable label error on the orderSell when the budget is exhausted.

likelyOwner.reason: MiguelHamelyn is assigned and authored the latest merged mitigation for this exact issue.
